lesson.name: Learn The King's Gambit
lesson.description: Learn the key variations, plans, and tactics for both sides in the King's Gambit.

{White should have escaped the queen check with Kf1 instead of blocking with
the g-pawn. How should Black take advantage?} 4... fxg3 {[%wrong There's a
better option. Try again and look for a way to win material.] [%hint Find a
good capture.]} 5. Nf3 {Good start! White hopes that attacking Black's queen
will turn the game around. What should Black play?} g2+ {[%wrong There's a
stronger move. Try again and look for good check.] [%hint Attack the h1-rook
with a discovered check.]} (5... Qxe4+ $5 {Black is doing well, but there's a
stronger check. Try to find it.}) (5... Qh5 $2 6. Qe2 {Black is better, but
there's a much stronger move. Try to find a good check.}) (5... gxh2+ $2 6.
Nxh4 {White wins the queen. Try again and look for a stronger check.}) 6. Nxh4
{Great move! What's next?} gxh1=Q+ {[%wrong There's a much stronger move. Try
again and look for a way to win material.] [%hint Capture a piece and make a
new queen.] Well done! Black gets the queen back, wins a rook, and should soon
win the game.} *

win material?} Bxf1 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try again and look for a
good capture.] [%hint Find a good capture.] Well played! Black wins an

{If Black makes a mistake then White can dominate the center in the King's
Gambit Accepted. How should you do it?} 4. d4 {[%wrong There's a stronger
option. Try again and look for a good threat.] [%hint Chase Black's bishop
from the center.]} (4. Nc3 $2 Nc6 {Black is OK. Try again and look for a more
forcing option.}) (4. d3 $2 d5 {Black is OK. Try again and look for a more
forcing option.}) 4... Bd6 {Good move! How should you quickly win back your
sacrificed pawn?} 5. e5 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look
for a good threat.] [%hint Attack Black's bishop again.]} (5. Bc4 $5 {This is
a reasonable move, but there's a threat that will help you quickly win back
your sacrificed pawn. How should you do it?}) (5. Nc3 $5 {This is a reasonable
move, but there's a threat that will help you quickly win back your sacrificed
pawn. How should you do it?}) (5. Bd3 $5 {This is a reasonable move, but
there's a threat that will help you quickly win back your sacrificed pawn. How
should you do it?}) (5. c3 $5 {This is a reasonable move, but there's a threat
that will help you quickly win back your sacrificed pawn. How should you do it?
}) 5... Be7 {Good work! How can you win back your sacrificed pawn?} 6. Bxf4 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Capture a pawn.] Well done! White has equalized material, leads in development, and dominates the center. This is the dream of any King's Gambit player.} *

{How should Black challenge the white center?} 5... c6 {[%wrong There's a
better option. Try again and look for a way to combat the white center.] 
[%hint Offer a trade for the d5-pawn.]} (5... Bd6 $5 {This is OK, but it's
better to challenge the d5-pawn. How should you do it?}) (5... Bc5 $2 6. d4 {
White has good center control and a solid position. Try again and look for a
strong pawn move.}) (5... Be7 $2 6. d4 {White has good center control and a

develop when you recapture. How can you do that?}) *

{White has sacrificed two pieces for a dangerous attack. How should Black
defend?} 9... Qf5 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for
the strongest queen move.] [%hint Save your queen, defend the f-file and leave f6
open for your knight.]} (9... Qxd4+ $5 10. Be3 {Black is doing well with
perfect play, but the position is very dangerous. Try again and look for a
safer queen move.}) (9... Qf6 $2 10. Bxf4 {It makes sense to defend the f-file,
but the f6-square should be reserved for your knight. Try again and look for a
stronger developing move.}) (9... Qg7 $2 10. Bxf4 {White has a dangerous
attack along the f-file. Try again and look for a better queen move.}) (9...
Qe6 $2 10. Bxf4 {White has a winning attack along the f-file. Try again and
look for a better queen move.}) (9... Qa5 $2 10. Qxf4+ {White has a winning
attack along the f-file. Try again and look for a better queen move.}) 10. Bxf4
{Very precise! How should you keep defending and develop at the same time?} Nf6
{[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find a strong developing move.] 
[%hint Develop a knight to block the f-file.] Well played! Black must still be
careful, but White doesn't objectively have enough compensation for the
sacrificed pieces.} (10... Bg7 $5 {This is reasonable, but it's safer to
develop and block the f-file. How should you do it?}) (10... Qxc2 $2 11. Bxc7+
{White will soon checkmate. Try again and look for a good way to develop and
block the f-file.}) (10... d6 $2 11. Qe3 {White has a dangerous attack. Try
again and look for a way to develop and block the f-file.}) (10... Bh6 $2 11.
Qb3+ {White will soon win material and Black is in trouble. Try again and look
for a better developing move.}) *

{Black has captured too much material instead of developing. How should White
take advantage?} 11. Qxf4+ {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try again and
look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn with check.]} (11. Qd5+ $2 Ke8
{Black is doing well. Try again and look for a strong capture.}) (11. Nc3 $2
Qxc3 {Black wins material. Try again and look for a more forcing option.}) (11.
Bxf4 $5 Qf6 {White is doing well, but it requires very precise play. Try again
and look for an even more convincing capture.}) 11... Qf6 {Great move! How
should you win the black queen?} 12. Qc4+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try
again and look for a stronger attacking option.] [%hint Find a winning check.]}
(12. Qh4 $5 {This is a good move, but there's a check that's even stronger.

winning the queen. Try to find a more forcing queen move.}) (12. Bd4 $2 Qxf4 {
Black gives back some material but keeps a good position. Try again and look
for a way to win the black queen.}) 12... Ke8 {Good move! How should you win
material?} 13. Rxf6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a
good capture.] [%hint Capture an important piece.] Well done! White wins the
queen and maintains a winning attack.} *

{White's knight looks aggressive on g5, but Black can win material. How should
you do it?} 5... h6 {[%wrong There's a better attacking move. Try again and
look for a strong threat.] [%hint Attack the g5-knight.]} (5... f3 $5 {This is
a good move, but let's win material right away. How can you do that?}) (5... d5
$5 {This is a good move, but let's win material right away. How can you do
that?}) (5... Nc6 $5 {This is a good move, but let's win material right away.

[%wrong White wins material. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Capture a piece.] Good choice! White has some attacking chances for the knight,
but Black should be able to defend and convert the extra material into a win
with precise play.} *

{Black's kingside attack looks scary, but White is at least OK. How should you
combine defense and counter-attack?} 10. Qe1 {[%wrong There's a stronger
attacking option. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Offer
a queen trade.]} (10. Bxf4 $2 g3 {Black wins material or mates on h2. Try
again and check the hint if you're stuck.}) (10. Bb5+ $2 Kf8 {Black's king is
actually safer on f8 than it was on e8. Try again and check the hint if you're
stuck.}) (10. Rxf4 $2 Nxf4 {Black wins material. Try again and check the hint
if you're stuck.}) 10... g3 {Black should have allowed the queen trade because
now White can win material. How should you do it?} 11. Ng6+ {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try again and look for a way to win the black queen.] [%hint Use
a discovered check to win the black queen.]} (11. Nf3+ $2 Qe7 {White is only
slightly better. Try again and look for a stronger check.}) 11... Kd8 {
Perfect! What's next?} 12. Nxh4 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again
and look for a good capture.] [%hint Find the best piece to capture.] Great
job! White wins the queen.} *

{White has sacrificed a piece, but will soon win it back with a sharp position.
What key move gives White a good game?} 11. Nb5 {[%wrong There's a better
option. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Over-protect the
d4-pawn and eye a potential knight fork on c7. ]} (11. Bb5+ $5 Bd7 {This is
playable, but there's a stronger use of the b5-square. Try to find it.}) (11.
dxe5 $2 Qc5+ {Black forks g1 and c4 to win a piece. Try again and check the
hint if you're stuck.}) (11. Re1 $2 Bxd4+ {After Qxd4 and Qxe1+ Black wins
material. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.}) 11... Nd7 {Black
couldn't save the bishop without allowing a deadly pin on the e-file. How
should White win material?} 12. dxe5 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try
again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture a piece.]} (12. Qxg4 $2 Ndf6
{Black defends the extra piece and White is in trouble. Try again and look for
a stronger capture.}) 12... Qc5+ {Now you can reveal the key point of Nb5. How
should White avoid material losses?} 13. Qd4 {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try to find the ideal way out of check.] [%hint Block the check and offer a
queen trade.]} (13. Nd4 $2 Qxc4 {Black wins material. Try again and look for a
better way out of check.}) (13. Kh1 $2 Qxc4 {Black wins material. Try again
and look for a better way out of check.}) 13... Qxd4+ {Nice move! What's next?}
14. Nxd4 {[%wrong Black is winning. Try again and look for a good capture.] 
[%hint Recapture the queen.] Well played! White is doing well and went on to
win in Berg - Grandelius, 2015.} *
